newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Jardine sells some Sizzler restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Jardine sells some Sizzler restaurants.

text.p: Jardine Australian Restaurant Group Pty Ltd, part of the Jardine Matheson group, said on Tuesday it had sold 39 Sizzler restaurants in four Australian states to UFH Holdings Pty Ltd.

The chairman of the Jardine group in Australia, Bob Sutton, told Reuters that the sale price would not be disclosed but there would be a capital loss which had been fully provided for in last year's accounts.
UFH, which trades as Bell's Restaurants, would convert the Sizzler restaurants in Victoria, South Australia, Tasmania and northern New South Wales to Bells Restaurants.
Sutton said UFH was led by former Sizzler employee Trevor Willoughby.
The remaining 36 Sizzler restaurants in Australia, which were operated by a franchisor, would remain open.
The Jardine Matheson trading conglomerate is based in Hong Kong but its main share market listing for the group and the holding company is in Singapore.
Sutton said the Sizzler sale was included in a A$65 million provision in the accounts of the parent company, which included a provision for other group activities in Thailand.
